description: Swift test source file containing unit tests for the NodeAppModel and related classes in the OpenClaw project. It includes mock classes for dependencies, tests for deep linking, notification handling, canvas commands, watch messaging, and other app behaviors.

classes.name: MockWatchMessagingService
classes.description: Mock implementation of WatchMessagingServicing, simulating watch messaging behavior for tests.

classes.name: MockBootstrapNotificationCenter
classes.description: Mock implementation of NotificationCentering, simulating notification authorization for tests.

methods.name: makeAgentDeepLinkURL
methods.description: Creates a deep link URL used for testing handling of deep links with message and optional parameters.

methods.name: decodeParamsFailsWithoutJSON
methods.description: Tests that decoding parameters fails with nil input.

methods.name: encodePayloadEmitsJSON
methods.description: Tests that encoding a payload produces JSON containing expected fields.

methods.name: chatSessionKeyDefaultsToMainBase
methods.description: Verifies that the default chat session key is 'main'.

methods.name: chatSessionKeyUsesAgentScopedKeyForNonDefaultAgent
methods.description: Verifies that chat session key uses agent-specific key when agent ID is set.

methods.name: operatorLoopWaitsForBootstrapHandoffBeforeUsingStoredToken
methods.description: Ensures operator gateway loop waits appropriately based on token and bootstrap token states.

methods.name: successfulBootstrapOnboardingRequestsNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Tests that notification authorization is requested during bootstrap onboarding.

methods.name: clearingBootstrapTokenStripsReconnectConfigEvenWithoutPersistence
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrap tokens are cleared from configuration.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsBackgroundCommands
methods.description: Tests rejecting background commands via handleInvoke.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsCameraWhenDisabled
methods.description: Tests that camera commands are rejected if disabled in user defaults.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsInvalidScreenFormat
methods.description: Tests rejection of invalid screen format parameters.

methods.name: handleInvokeCanvasCommandsUpdateScreen
methods.description: Verifies processing of canvas commands such as navigate, eval, and present.

methods.name: pendingForegroundActionsReplayCanvasNavigate
methods.description: Tests replaying pending foreground actions that involve navigation.

methods.name: pendingForegroundActionsDoNotApplyWhileBackgrounded
methods.description: Ensures foreground actions are not applied when app is backgrounded.

methods.name: handleInvokeA2UICommandsFailWhenHostMissing
methods.description: Tests failure responses for missing A2UI host configurations.

methods.name: handleInvokeUnknownCommandReturnsInvalidRequest
methods.description: Verifies that unknown commands yield invalid request errors.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchStatusReturnsServiceSnapshot
methods.description: Tests retrieval of watch status information.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyRoutesToWatchService
methods.description: Verifies that watch notification requests are routed and sent properly.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyRejectsEmptyMessage
methods.description: Ensures empty messages are rejected in watch notifications.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyAddsDefaultActionsForPrompt
methods.description: Tests that default actions are added to notifications with prompts.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyAddsApprovalDefaults
methods.description: Verifies approval notification defaults are set correctly.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyDerivesPriorityFromRiskAndCapsActions
methods.description: Tests priority derivation logic based on risk and actions.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyReturnsUnavailableOnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Checks that delivery failures result in 'unavailable' error responses.

methods.name: watchReplyQueuesWhenGatewayOffline

methods.description: Tests that deep links set an error when not connected.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRejectsOversizedMessage
methods.description: Verifies rejection of messages that are too large.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRequiresConfirmationWhenConnectedAndUnkeyed
methods.description: Checks confirmation prompt when deep linking while connected without an agent key.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkCoalescesPromptWhenRateLimited
methods.description: Ensures deep link prompts are coalesced when rate-limited.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkStripsDeliveryFieldsWhenUnkeyed
methods.description: Verifies that delivery fields are stripped in deep links when unkeyed.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRejectsLongUnkeyedMessageWhenConnected
methods.description: Tests rejection of overly long unkeyed messages while connected.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkBypassesPromptWithValidKey
methods.description: Verifies that valid deep link keys bypass prompts.
